FOREWORD 


This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Pesticides 
Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food and Agriculture Division Council. 
Thiodicarb technical is employed in the preparation of Insecticide formulations. 


Thiodicarb is the IUPAC name for (3EZ,12EZ)-3,7,9,13-tetramethyl-5,11-dioxa-2,8,14-trithia-4,7,9,12- 
tetraazapentadeca-3,12-diene-6, 10-dione. 


The empirical and structural formula and the molecular mass of thiodicarb are given below:

In the formulation of this standard, due consideration has been given to the provisions of Insecticides Act, 1968 
and the Rules framed thereunder. However, this standard is subject to the restrictions imposed under the 
Insecticides Act and Rules, wherever applicable. 


For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with the final value, 
observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS 2 : 1960 ‘Rules for rounding off numerical values (revised). The number of significant places retained in the 
rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

THIODICARB, TECHNICAL — 
SPECIFICATION 


1 SCOPE 


This standard specifies the requirements and methods 
of sampling and test for thiodicarb technical. 


2 REFERENCES 


The standards given below contain provisions which, 
through reference in this text, constitute provisions of 
this standard. At the time of publication, the editions 
indicated were valid. All standards are subject to 
revision, and parties to agreements based on this 
standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility 
of applying the most recent editions of these standards: 


IS No. Title

Specification (third revision) 
6940 : 1982 Methods of test for pesticides 


and their formulations ( first 
revision) 
8190 (Part 1): 1988 Requirements for packing 
of pesticides: Part 1 Solid 


pesticides (second revision) 


3 REQUIREMENTS 


3.1 Description 
The material shall be in powder form having pale 
brown or grey colour. 


3.2 The material shall also comply with the requirements 
given in Table 1. 


4 TESTS 


4.1 Tests shall be carried out by the methods referred in 
column 4 and 5 of Table 1. 


4.2 Quality of Reagents 


Unless specified otherwise, pure chemicals and reagent 
grade water (see IS 1070), shall be employed in the 
tests. 


NOTE — ‘Pure chemicals’ shall mean chemicals that do not 
contain impurities which affect the results of analysis. 


5 PACKING 


The material shall be packed in fibre board box, 
provided with low density polyethylene (LDPE), 
liner of thickness not less than 0.062 mm. The general

6 MARKING 


6.1 The sack shall bear legibly and indelibly the 
following information in addition to any other 
information as is necessary under Insecticides Act, 
1968 and Rules framed thereunder: 


a) Name of the material; 

b) Name and address of the manufacturer; 

c) Batch number; 

d) Date of manufacture; 

e) Date of expiry; 

f) Net quantity; 

g) Nominal thiodicarb content, percent (m/m); 


h) Cautionary notice as worded in the /nsecticides 
Act, 1968, and Rules framed thereunder; and 


j) Any other information required under the Legal 
Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. 


6.2 BIS Certification Marking 


The product may also be marked with the Standard 
Mark. 


6.2.1 The use of the standard mark is governed by the 
provisions of Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 
and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The 
details of the conditions under which the licence for use 
of the Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers 
or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of 
Indian Standards. 


7 SAMPLING 


Representative samples shall be drawn as prescribed in 
IS 10946.

ANNEX A 
[Table 1, SI No. (1) ] 


DETERMINATION OF THIODICARB CONTENT 


A-1 PRINCIPLE 


Thiodicarb content is determined by High Performance 
Liquid chromatography (HPLC) with UV-VIS detector, 
using internal standard technique. 


A-2 APPARATUS 


A-2.1 High Performance Liquid chromatograph 
(HPLC), equipped with UV-VIS detector and coupled 
to a printer-plotter-cum-integrator. The operative 
conditions suggested below are typical, which can be 
changed provided the standardization is done. 


Column Stainless steel, C-18, Sum, 0.25 m 
length and 4.6 mm ID 

Mobile Phase Acetonitrile : Water (65 : 35 v/v) 

Flow rate 1.4 ml/min 

Detector UV detector (240 nm) 

Injection volume 20ul 


A-2.2 Microlitre Syringe — 5/20 ul 
A-2.3 Glasswares 


A-3 REAGENTS 
A-3.1 Acetonitrile — HPLC grade or equivalent. 
A-3.2 Water — HPLC grade or equivalent. 


A-3.3 Internal Standard — Thymol AR grade or 
equivalent. 


A-3.4 Thiodicarb References Standard — of known 
purity. 


A-4 PROCEDURE 
A-4.1 Preparation of Internal Standard Solution 


Weigh accurately 25 mg ofthymol in a25 ml volumetric 
flask and make up to mark with acetonitrile. Shake well 
to homogenize. 


A-4.2 Preparation of Standard Solution. 


Weigh accurately 25 mg of thiodicarb reference 
standard, in a 25 ml volumetric flask, add 5 ml of 
internal standard and finally make up the volume to the 
mark with acetonitrile. Shake well to homogenize. 


A-4.3 Preparation of Sample Solution 


Weigh accurately a quantity of sample so as to contain 
about 25 mg of thiodicarb in a 25 ml volumetric flask, 
add 5 ml of the internal standard solution and finally 
make up the volume to the mark with acetonitrile. 
Shake well to homogenize. 


A-4.4 Estimation 


A-4.4.1 After suitable dilution, inject 20 ul of the 
standard solution in the high performance liquid 
chromatography, followed by the sample solution with 
the help of syringe. Measure peak areas of standard 
and sample solution. Compute the percentage of 
thiodicarb content in the sample. 


A-4.4.2 Retention Time (Guide Values): 


Thiodicarb - 2.6 min 
Internal standard (Thymol) - 43 min 
Total runtime - 7.0 min 
A-5 CALCULATION 
M x A, x A, xp 
PH 0 = — 3 2 5 
Thiodicarb content, % by mass ETRE 


where, 

M, = mass of the standard thiodicarb in standard 
solution, in g; 

M,= mass of the sample taken for test, in g; 

A,= peak area of thiodicarb, in the chromatogram 
of standard solution; 

A,= peak area of thiodicarb, in the chromatogram 
of sample solution; 

A,=peak area of internal standard, in the 
chromatogram of standard solution; 

A, = peak area of internal standard, in the 
chromatogram of sample solution; and 


p =percent purity of thiodicarb reference 


standard.

Review of Indian Standards 


Amendments are issued to standards as the need arises on the basis of comments. Standards are also reviewed 
periodically; a standard along with amendments is reaffirmed when such review indicates that no changes are 
needed; if the review indicates that changes are needed, it is taken up for revision. Users of Indian Standards 
should ascertain that they are in possession of the latest amendments or edition by referring to the latest issue of 
“BIS Catalogue” and “Standards: Monthly Additions’.
